description_for_human: Review opportunities and create explicitly confirmed simulated quotes.

functions.name: get_sales_dashboard
functions.description: Returns the sales dashboard from synthetic data or a configured read-only CRM MCP server.

functions.name: get_opportunity
functions.description: Returns one opportunity and its fixed PoC quote catalog.

functions.name: preview_quote
functions.description: Creates or revises a Blob-backed simulated quote draft.

functions.name: save_demo_quote
functions.description: Explicitly confirms and idempotently saves a simulated quote. It never writes to CRM.

functions.name: get_demo_quote
functions.description: Reads a previously saved simulated quote from identity-scoped Blob storage.
